summary: Verified audio-stability bug fix. Instrumented window.speechSynthesis.speak and captured /api/tts/ network. In Recognize (Numerot 1-10) and Match (Värit) tasks, browser-voice fallback was NEVER invoked (0 calls) across a full round; all TTS requests returned 200; prefetch fires on game mount as designed. Blob cache prevents repeat HTTP after first fetch. Fix appears solid.

match_colors.note: 0 extra HTTP during matching is EXPECTED - blob cache serves speak() from memory. Confirmed via console logs that BROWSER_VOICE_SPEAK never printed.

critical_code_review_comments: audio.js: getAudio() correctly stores the Promise in cache immediately (prevents duplicate parallel fetches) and evicts on null resolution to allow retry. Good.
_seq sequence guard is monotonic and only the latest speak() may fall back — matches the reported fix intent.
stopCurrent() clears onended/onerror before pause() to avoid spurious onEnd firing on interruption. Good.
Minor: URL.createObjectURL blobs are never revoked - small memory leak per unique slug, but bounded by vocabulary size (~234), acceptable.
Minor: speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged assignment overwrites any prior handler; not an issue here but worth noting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Instrumentation approach: page.add_init_script wrapping window.speechSynthesis.speak to count calls; page.on('response') to capture /api/tts/ requests. Match testids are match-word-<en> and match-image-<en> (correct pair shares english word). Back button testid is 'back-button' not 'header-back'.
